title: Caltech Mathathon – first hackathon ever devoted to research level mathematics
why_read: An interesting novel event combining hackathon culture with research mathematics, appealing to a niche but technically sophisticated audience.
analysis: This describes what's billed as the first hackathon focused on research-level mathematics rather than typical software projects, a notable experiment in applying rapid collaborative problem-solving to pure math research. It's more of a community/event story than a technical deep-dive, but the format itself—bringing hackathon methodology to math research—is a genuinely novel and interesting concept for engineers with mathematical interests. Limited lasting technical takeaway beyond the concept itself.
